discussion.p:
Paper added feature-test macro `__cpp_lib_reflection`, exposed only in <meta> (and <version>). It also added entities to <type_traits>, such as `std::is_reflection`.
The mentioned feature-test macro should therefore be added to <type_traits> as well.
